meta.note: Colours are the shipped Web UI palette, unchanged. Type, spacing, radius and layout are the redesign's scale, built on the shipped values.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, and the sunken fill of inputs, wells and cards nested inside a panel.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, stat tiles, feature and team cards, the side nav, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Table header row, table row hover, hovered tiles, dialog footer.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Top bar, side-nav hover, the save bar, empty-state icon discs.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The current nav item, feature-card icon wells, info callouts.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Neutral buttons, pills, count badges, the selected segment, avatar discs.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything on fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: panel edges, table rows, dividers. Never the edge of a control (1.6:1).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, switches, segmented controls and hovered cards: 3.97:1 on bg, 3.66:1 on surface, 3.08:1 on chrome (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and values, on every surface: 15.1:1 on bg, 14:1 on surface, 11.8:1 on chrome, 8.3:1 on fill.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Nav links, field labels, disclosure summaries, secondary headings: 11.7:1 on surface, 9.9:1 on chrome.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, metadata, help text, table headers, overlines: 7.4:1 on bg, 6.8:1 on surface, 5.7:1 on chrome. Only 4.0:1 on fill, so never on fill.

tokens.name: pill-text
tokens.usage: Text on fill pills and neutral badges (7:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary (5.2:1), danger (4.8:1), fill and selected; the current nav item's label.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on bg, surface, surface-alt, chrome and selected (5.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px so it lands on the surface: 10.5:1 on bg, 9.7:1 on surface, 8.1:1 on chrome.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary button per view, the switch track when on, the current tab underline, meter fills (3.4:1 on surface as a mark).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons with on-primary text (4.8:1), the invalid-field outline.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button hover.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Inline warning text and the low-session timer, on surface (8.1:1), bg and chrome.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: ON badges and success callouts, always with ok-text.

tokens.name: ok-text
tokens.usage: Text on ok-bg (7.5:1); also an ON status dot on any surface (14:1).

tokens.name: err-bg
tokens.usage: OFF badges and error callouts, always with err-text.

tokens.name: err-text
tokens.usage: Text on err-bg (9.7:1); also an error or OFF status dot on any surface (12:1).

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Info badges (ACTIVE, NEW) and the update-available pill, with info-text.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Text on info-bg (7.3:1) and on selected (10.1:1); icons in feature-card wells.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warning badges, warning callouts and issue counts, with warn-text.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Text on warn-bg (8.9:1); also a warning status dot on any surface (14:1).

tokens.name: heat-empty
tokens.usage: Empty heatmap cell. Decorative (1.2:1 on surface): every value is also in the cell's label and the bar list.

tokens.name: lore-deep
tokens.usage: Rewind hero ground, with lore-text. Activity data only.

tokens.name: lore
tokens.usage: The current Rewind year chip and the hero's edge. Activity data only.

tokens.name: lore-fill
tokens.usage: Heatmap cells and activity bars (cell intensity is its opacity). Activity data only.

tokens.name: lore-peak
tokens.usage: The peak hour or day in a heatmap or bar list (8.7:1 on surface), named in text beside it.

tokens.name: lore-text
tokens.usage: Text on lore-deep (10.7:1) and lore (7.7:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind an open dialog: bg at 70%. Added in the redesign.

tokens.name: embed-brand
tokens.usage: Discord embed accent bar: KoolBot's own messages (help, welcome, notices headers, announcements by default). Replaces Discord blurple 0x5865f2. Mid-tones read on both Discord themes (3.4:1 dark, 3.7:1 light); the bar is decorative, the title carries the meaning.

tokens.name: embed-ok
tokens.usage: Embed accent: something worked or is on (a role given, a feature enabled, an event live). Replaces 0x00ff00 and 0x57f287.

tokens.name: embed-warn
tokens.usage: Embed accent: needs attention (a warning, a reminder, a lockdown notice).

tokens.name: embed-danger
tokens.usage: Embed accent: failed, removed or punitive (errors, bans, cancelled events). Replaces 0xff0000 and 0xed4245.

tokens.name: embed-neutral
tokens.usage: Embed accent: plain information (notices in a category without its own colour, game server details).

tokens.name: embed-lore
tokens.usage: Embed accent: activity and history (voicestats, Rewind, the weekly digest, quotes, achievements).

styles.name: stat-hero
styles.usage: The one headline number on a page (Rewind total). Tabular figures.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The page's h1, once per page.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The value in a stat tile. Tabular figures.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Dialog titles and a section heading that sits outside a panel.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Panel, team-card and issue titles. Added in the redesign: panels are smaller and more numerous than the old cards.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Nothing here changes anything in Discord.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Nav items, tables, setting names, inputs: the default size inside the app shell.

styles.name: description
styles.sample: Clan tags are not applied to nicknames.
styles.usage: One-line descriptions under a setting, tile or card, in muted.

styles.name: help
styles.sample: Only has an effect while clan tags are on.
styles.usage: Help under a field, in muted.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Nav group headings, tile labels, table headers. Uppercase via CSS.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Config keys, snowflake ids, versions, the session timer.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in badges; label-to-control gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons, chips and inline items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gap between tiles and cards; callout padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel body padding (with space-5 sides); gap between stacked panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Main column top padding; page header to content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Main column side padding; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Heatmap cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, segmented-control segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, callouts, cards nested in a panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles, feature and team cards, dialogs, the save bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, count badges, switch tracks, avatars.

shadow.note: Borders separate; shadows only lift what floats over the page.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the sticky save bar only. Added in the redesign.

layout.note: Shell measures. The 760px reflow breakpoint is from #855.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar height; the shell is 100vh minus this.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Admin side nav. Wider than the old 220px to fit icons.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Admin main column max width.

tokens.name: member-content-max
tokens.usage: Member pages (My preferences, host panel): one centred column.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Inputs and selects.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Buttons; 1.75rem for the small size.
